/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN

 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);

/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DCLTN_INVOICES');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$LOV_UPD_INV_COST_GLOBALS.DCLTN_INVOICES_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$LOV_UPD_INV_COST_GLOBALS.DCLTN_INVOICES_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_INVOICES.CURCY_ARBC_NAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CURCY_ARBC_NAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CURCY_ARBC_NAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CURCY_ARBC_NAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';

/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;

 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'MIN_EXMTD_QTY') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الإعفاء للصنف - الكمية لايمكن أن تكون أقل من الصفر', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MIN_EXMTD_DUTY') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الإعفاء للصنف - الرسوم لايمكن أن تكون أقل من الصفر', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MIN_EXMTD_CIF') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الإعفاء للصنف - القيمة لايمكن أن تكون أقل من الصفر', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE copy_selected_values
IS
 msg_lvl VARCHAR2 (5);
 v_msg VARCHAR2 (500);
 v_msg0 VARCHAR2 (500);
 v_msg1 VARCHAR2 (500);
 v_msg2 VARCHAR2 (500);
 v_sts NUMBER;
 v_rec NUMBER;
 v_count NUMBER;
 ret NUMBER;
 v_cif_val NUMBER := 0;
 v_duty_val NUMBER := 0;
 aaa NUMBER := 0;
 v_inv_amt NUMBER := 0;
 v_new_duty NUMBER := 0;
 v_total_exps NUMBER := 0;
 v_inv_cost NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 msg_lvl := :SYSTEM.message_level;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := '25';
 v_sts := 0;
 v_msg0 := 'تم التعديل';
 v_msg1 := 'توجد رسوم إضافية يجب تسديدها قبل التعديل';
 v_msg2 := 'إجمالي قيمة الأصناف لا يساوي إجمالي قيمة الفواتير';
 v_count := 0;
 v_inv_amt := 0;
 v_new_duty := 0;
 v_total_exps := 0;
 v_inv_cost := 0;

 BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK ('DCLTN_ITEMS');
 GO_ITEM ('DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ');
 LAST_RECORD;
 v_rec := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 v_count := 0;

 FOR i IN 1 .. v_rec
 LOOP
 v_cif_val := 0;
 v_duty_val := 0;
 IF NVL(:old_orgnl_duty,0) = 0 THEN
 :old_orgnl_duty := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('ORGNL_DUTY', database_value);
 END IF;
 aaa :=
 duty.pre_calc_item_duty (:parameter.p_port_cd,
 :GLOBAL.port_type,
 :GLOBAL.dcltn_type_cd,
 :GLOBAL.final_ctry_cd,
 :item_isn,
 v_msg,
 v_cif_val,
 v_duty_val
 );

 IF aaa = 1
 THEN
 :cif_cost := v_cif_val;
 :orgnl_duty := v_duty_val;
 END IF;

 UPDATE dcltn_items
 SET inv_cost = :inv_cost,
 cif_cost = :cif_cost,
 cif_cost_wt_disc = :cif_cost,
 orgnl_duty = :orgnl_duty,
 exmtd_duty = :exmtd_duty
 WHERE port_cd = :parameter.p_port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :parameter.p_dcltn_isn
 AND inv_isn = :parameter.p_inv_isn
 AND item_isn = :item_isn;

 SYNCHRONIZE;

 IF i <> v_rec
 THEN
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 SELECT SUM (total_exps)
 INTO v_total_exps
 FROM dcltn_invoices
 WHERE port_cd = :parameter.p_port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :parameter.p_dcltn_isn
 AND inv_isn = :parameter.p_inv_isn;

 SELECT SUM (inv_cost)
 INTO v_inv_cost
 FROM dcltn_items
 WHERE port_cd = :parameter.p_port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :parameter.p_dcltn_isn
 AND inv_isn = :parameter.p_inv_isn;

 IF v_total_exps <> v_inv_cost
 THEN
 v_sts := 2;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM (NVL (orgnl_duty, 0) - NVL (exmtd_duty, 0))
 INTO v_new_duty
 FROM dcltn_items
 WHERE port_cd = :parameter.p_port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :parameter.p_dcltn_isn
 AND inv_isn = :parameter.p_inv_isn;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF :GLOBAL.org_duty < v_new_duty
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM coll_orders, coll_order_dtls
 WHERE coll_orders.coll_ordr_ctgry = 9
 AND coll_orders.coll_ordr_type = 1
 AND coll_orders.coll_ordr_sta = 2
 AND coll_order_dtls.acct_seq = 1
 AND coll_order_dtls.amt > 0
 AND coll_orders.port_cd = :parameter.p_port_cd
 AND coll_orders.dcltn_isn = :parameter.p_dcltn_isn
 AND coll_orders.port_cd = coll_order_dtls.port_cd
 AND coll_orders.coll_ordr_nbr =
 coll_order_dtls.coll_ordr_nbr
 AND coll_orders.coll_ordr_dt = coll_order_dtls.coll_ordr_dt
 AND coll_orders.coll_ordr_ctgry =
 coll_order_dtls.coll_ordr_ctgry;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) = 0
 THEN
 v_sts := 1;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.org_duty > v_new_duty
 THEN
 BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK ('DCLTN_ITEMS');
 GO_ITEM ('DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ');
 LAST_RECORD;
 v_rec := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 FIRST_RECORD;

 FOR i IN 1 .. v_rec
 LOOP
 IF NVL (:old_orgnl_duty, 0) > 0
 THEN
 UPDATE dcltn_items
 SET orgnl_duty = :old_orgnl_duty
 WHERE port_cd = :parameter.p_port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :parameter.p_dcltn_isn
 AND inv_isn = :parameter.p_inv_isn
 AND item_isn = :item_isn;
 END IF;

 SYNCHRONIZE;

 IF i <> v_rec
 THEN
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 :SYSTEM.message_level := msg_lvl;

 IF v_sts = 1
 THEN
 str.dispalert (v_msg1, 'ERROR');
 FORMS_DDL ('ROLLBACK');
 EXIT_FORM (no_validate);
 ELSIF v_sts = 2
 THEN
 str.dispalert (v_msg2, 'ERROR');
 FORMS_DDL ('ROLLBACK');
 EXIT_FORM (no_validate);
 ELSE
 str.dispalert (v_msg0, 'ERROR');
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 EXIT_FORM (no_validate);
 END IF;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE

 errtyp VARCHAR2(20) := ERROR_TYPE;
 alert_is alert;
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);

 BEGIN
 IF errnum = 41051 then
 null;
 else
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;

 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
end if;
 END;
